news.title:
Navin Fluorine to invest ₹5.5 crore for 26% stake in 5 MW hybrid power project.
The company has signed a 15-year power supply agreement for the project.

Navin Fluorine's subsidiary NFASL invests ₹5.5 Cr in Pro Zeal Green Power SPV for 26% equity in a hybrid power project.
The 15-year agreement ensures 5MW power supply for NFASL's Dahej Unit, aiding cost savings and sustainability.
Upcoming dividend of ₹8.60 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 12 June 2026. Payment date: 05 September 2026. Payout ratio is a comfortable 12% and this is well supported by cash flows. Trailing yield: 0.2%. Lower than top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.5%). Lower than average of industry peers (0.8%).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹131 (up from ₹58.20 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹33.8b (up 44% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.64b (up 130% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 20% (up from 12% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 5.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 13% per year.

news.title: Navin Fluorine International Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-2026, Payable on August 13, 2026
news.body: Navin Fluorine International Limited Board of Directors has recommended final dividend of INR 8.60/- per equity share of the face value of INR 2/- each (i.e. 430% of the face value) for the financial year 2025-2026 subject To Approve the Members of the Company at the forthcoming 28 Annual General Meeting to be held on August 06, 2026. As per Regulation 42 of SEBI Listing Regulations, June 12, 2026 is fixed as Record Date for ascertaining eligibility for the payment of final dividend for the financial year 2025-2026, if declared. On declaration, the final dividend will be paid on or after, August 13, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹36.18 (up from ₹16.86 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹9.08b (up 50% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.85b (up 122% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 20% (up from 14% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 12%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 22%. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 8% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 17% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Price target increased by 9.9% to ₹6,458
news.body: Up from ₹5,878, the current price target is an average from 26 analysts. New target price is approximately in line with last closing price of ₹6,598. Stock is up 62% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹123 for next year compared to ₹58.20 last year.
